I'm finding the word "prefix" here is confusing because I don't know what it is a prefix of. What do you think of this alternative wording:

> To **parse an advertising data filter** from a [string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string) *input*:

Note that I use the "string" concept from the [infra](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/) spec rather than the ECMA262 string concept, since we are talking about strings in the abstract and not specifically Javascript strings. I also follow the style from that spec and don't explicitly define the type of the result value.
